rows.en:
Zero-One's weakness is that he's soft on women and children!

This time… we'll set a trap using Rieko and Akira! Don't fail again, Shadow Knight…
Leave it to me… Using Bijinder, this time I'll defeat Zero-One before your very eyes!
Heh heh heh… Hahaha!

Taaah! Ohohohohoho…

You two are going to be my bait! To lure out Zero-One…
Ah… a Shadow robot!?
Akira!

…!?

Who are you?
Who cares who I am!
Get in my way and you'll be sorry!
What are you lot planning to do to a woman and a child?

Taki, leave this to me…

You get those two somewhere safe…

Right…

Come on, this way!
So you mean to defy me? Prepare yourself!
Bring it on! Here I come!

That sound…?

Zero-One!?
Taking women and children hostage, you coward! I'll accept your challenge without any of that!
Zero-One!?
Ichiro!

(At this rate, the hostages are no use! I'll have to think up another plan to kill Zero-One…)

Zero-One! Don't you forget this! Taaah!
Wait! Bijinder!
Taaah!

…!?

Mari!
I'm amazed… I didn't know there were people like you around.
You know… I can never forgive guys like those Shadow Robots!
Akira, Rieko… are you hurt?
Thank you so much. You've saved us from danger so many times…
What's that move of yours called?
Um… I'm sorry. I have somewhere to be…
We have to hurry too…
Wait!
What's the secret behind why DARK and Shadow are so determined to get Akira?
You know, don't you? No, I won't let you say you don't!

I do know…

But I can't tell you! If I did, Akira… poor Akira would…
Poor Akira?
Speaking of poor things… you're hurt, aren't you?
I'm fine. It's only a scratch…

Here, let me take a look! I've got medicine on my bike…

Hey, Hayato! Bring the medicine from my bike!
Why me!? Jeez, he's hopeless…
Um, it's all right! I'm really fine…

Don't be shy! Ah… that guy?

He's sort of my errand boy! I'm giving him special attention. Hahaha…

Anyway, come on… let me take a look.
Please take care of Rieko and Akira. Well then, I'll be…

Um…

Could you at least tell me your name…?

…………

Mari…

Mari?

I'm Kazuya Taki…
Well then…
Mari, huh…
Taki, I brought it for you! Here's the medicine…

Hayato, put it on yourself…

What a lovely name…
What…!? Akira is?
It can't be…!? Akira is Gill's child…

I… was Akira's caretaker!

But when I thought that if Akira grew up like this, he might end up like Gill…
So… that's why you took Akira and ran from the DARK base?
That must have been really hard on you…
You said Akira has another brother, didn't you? Where is he now?

I don't know… I don't even know his face!

All I know is that he's two years older than Akira and his name is Hiroshi. He had a different caretaker…
Then Hiroshi has someone like you looking after him too?

Her name is Misao, but…

whether she's still at the DARK base, or escaped… whether she's even still with Hiroshi…?

Misao? Hiroshi?

I once rescued a woman being attacked by Destron, along with a boy about Akira's age… I'm pretty sure those were their names.
Then they both escaped from the DARK base!
If you combine the blueprints written on Akira's and Hiroshi's backs, what on earth do you get?

…!?

A huge… a terrifying robot that Gill had been researching in secret, the Giant Devil… They become the complete blueprint of that robot.

If the Giant Devil is ever put into action, even all of you might not be able to win!

The Giant Devil is a devil of a robot that must never be brought into this world!

The Giant Devil has the power to destroy the Earth!
Jiro…
Brother…

The Giant Devil, huh…

What a lovely name…

I'm an android…

I tried to tell him that, but I couldn't…

…!?

That boy is the one from before…?
Ah, big sister…
It's dangerous, stay hidden…
Thank you, big sister…
What happened to Rieko? Going around on your own is dangerous.

…………

I'm sorry. But I… I'm sick of all this!
Eh… What happened?

Akira, Bijinder!

So this is where you were? You suddenly disappeared, and everyone's worried! Come on, let's go back to Rieko!

Brother Ichiro…

But… what do you mean, Bijinder?

Bijinder!

The you right now must be the real you! Bijinder!
I don't know what you're talking about!

I knew you were an android… right from the start.

Bijinder! Your true nature… is a kind-hearted android of justice.
Stop it!

Brother Ichiro! How can you say that!

Someone this kind… Shadow's Bijinder!?
It's just as Ichiro says… I am Bijinder.

U11511/U11515: 教意孫 read as 教育係 "caretaker".
U11525-U11526: Mari's monologue continues into a narration-kind row.
